name: smartbugs
description: SmartBugs dataset (https://github.com/smartbugs/smartbugs) — 10 classic vulnerable Solidity contracts with per-line vulnerability labels. Categories are mapped to the Web3Guard analyzer vocabulary from the original SmartBugs labels (see smartbugs-original-labels.json). Curation: BecToken and Rubixi additionally carry vulnerabilities that are genuinely present in the source but absent from the original SmartBugs labels — BecToken (unmitigated approve/transferFrom race, SWC-114) and Rubixi (unchecked .send in the payout loop, SWC-113). Note: several samples carry a source header 'Upgraded from Solidity 0.4 to 0.8, vulnerability may no longer exist' — e.g. BecToken (0.8 checked arithmetic reverts on overflow) and MyToken (0.8 ABI decoder rejects malformed input), so those labels are stale for the 0.8.24 versions in this corpus.
